# sentry_project_key (Data Source)

Looks up a client key of a project, for example the `Default` key Sentry creates with every project, to read its DSN. With neither `id` nor `name`, the project must have exactly one key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The key Sentry creates with every project.
data "sentry_project_key" "default" {
  project = "api"
  name    = "Default"
}

output "sentry_dsn" {
  value = data.sentry_project_key.default.dsn_public
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project` (String) ID or slug of the project.

### Optional

- `id` (String) Client key ID (its public key). Conflicts with `name`.
- `name` (String) Name of the client key (case-insensitive, exact). Conflicts with `id`.

### Read-Only

- `dsn_public` (String) The DSN to configure SDKs with.
- `dsn_secret` (String, Sensitive) Legacy DSN that embeds the secret key.
- `endpoints` (Map of String) The key's other ingestion endpoints by name, as Sentry reports them.
- `is_active` (Boolean) Whether the key accepts events.
- `project_id` (String) ID of the project the key belongs to.
- `public_key` (String) Public key.
- `secret_key` (String, Sensitive) Secret key.
